integrity: Analytic proof via exact pair-correlation ODE, tagged-site terminal balance, and a stopped birth-death potential; standalone labelled-state computational cross-check; independence not claimed.
scientific_limitations: No exact full flip-count law, optimal asymptotic of the probability of any upward founder flip, or extension to generic initial densities is claimed. Previously published zero-flip persistence formulas are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_scope: Ordinary rate-one independent-vertex copying on a labelled complete graph, started with exactly one opinion-one founder, absorption-stopped founder opinion-change count.
title: A rare-return paradox for the founding voter on a complete network
